case.expected_behavior: VBAT 3.1 V to 4.5 V, typical 3.8 V.

result.question: What voltage range can I feed the bare module from?
result.answer: The C16QS module power supply range is between 3.1V – 4.5V [HW-v5.3-p028-1]. The module input voltage for VBAT_BB and VBAT_RF pins is specified with a minimum of 3.1V, a typical value of 3.8V, and a maximum of 4.5V [HW-v5.3-p027-2].

result.question: Which pin do I pull low to switch the module on?
result.answer: The 15th pin of the C16QS module, labeled PWRKEY_N, is the power key. The module can be powered on by pulling down the POWER_KEY low for at least 500ms.

case.question: How much humidity can the module tolerate?

result.question: How much humidity can the module tolerate?
result.answer: The module supports a humidity range of RH5% to RH95% [HW-v5.3-p014-1]. Additionally, storage conditions specify that when the ambient temperature is greater than 40 degrees Celsius, air humidity must be less than 90% [HW-v5.3-p070-1]. Once the vacuum sealed bag is opened, the module requires an ambient temperature lower than 30 degrees Celsius and air humidity less than 60% for the factory to complete the patch within 72 hours [HW-v5.3-p070-1].

result.question: How do I put the EVK into flight mode?
result.answer: To enable Flight mode (W_Disable) on the Cavli C16QS EVK, you must use Jumper 9 (JMP 9) [EVK-v1.1-p013-1]. The FLIGHT_MODE pin is used to put the module into Flight mode and disable the RF transmission [HW-v5.3-p051-1].

case.question: Which port gives out the GNSS location data?

result.question: Which port gives out the GNSS location data?
result.answer: The GNSS NMEA data is obtained using the UART2 serial port, which consists of pins 22 and 23 [HW-v5.3-p035-1]. Additionally, the GNSS interface uses GNSS_TXD and GNSS_RXD pins for fetching NMEA logs [HW-v5.3-p052-1].
